Kavya Rao: Quick follow-up from today's runtime segment, capturing action items.
Tom Gray: Are hosted p95 targets measured at 8k context and warm cache?
Kavya Rao: Yes 12 hosted p95 = 120ms at 8k, steady-state (warmed cache). Dedicated SLA = 100ms p95.
Nisha Verma: Will you post the tiny latency_budget config we can paste into perf infra?
Kavya Rao: Yes 12 I'll add a 5-line YAML later today.
Tom Gray: Also want clarity on eviction short-term mitigations 12 tenant saw tail spikes.
sre-oncall: Short-term: bump tenant_cache_ttl + lower global_pressure threshold. Runtime to publish algorithm for long-term fix.
Nisha Verma: Can we get kernel-level tracing (kernel_name, kernel_ms) behind a flag?
Kavya Rao: Adding kernel spans next sprint behind a feature flag.
deploy-bot: canary queued: runtime/kernel-aot-proto -> canary group alpha (job 13101) :rocket: 
Kavya Rao: Actions: Nisha watch for YAML, Tom run local perf after config, Runtime publish eviction doc, SRE monitor canary. Ping me if anything missing.
Tom Gray: thanks :thumbsup:
